items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Dameron wrote a lot of stuff for Dizzy.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Tadd Dameron was one of those type of arrangers. The arrangements that Tadd Dameron did, you could see that he was going to be famous, too. In later years he wrote for practically everybody here in New York, all the big names. Dameron wrote a lot of stuff for Dizzy. / I would say at this time I did quite a bit of reading, musically. I practiced quite a bit because I was getting ready to go to New York for my second chance.
Second try at it. How did that take place and when?
